plain_statement: For every AND/OR circuit on 26 inputs with each gate reading exactly two earlier wires, every input index m and every list of base values, there is an assignment of a second bit to the wires that is 1 on input m only among the inputs, gives an AND of a, b the value (a0 and b1) or (a1 and b0) with a0, b0 from the list, and an OR the OR of the second bits.
